calls.head: Chicago feeds on loose pucks
calls.body: NY Islanders gives up more dangerous chances after losing the puck than most (31st of 32 at avoiding breakdowns). Chicago ranks 8th for chances off turnovers.

calls.happened: 4.2% of Chicago’s 5-on-5 chances came right after winning the puck, against its usual 7.6%.

calls.head: Depth against star power
calls.body: NY Islanders ranks 2nd of 32 for depth, toward the deep end; Chicago ranks 23rd, toward the top-heavy end.

surprises.head: Chicago tried a different line
surprises.body: A. Frondell, R. Kantserov, T. Bertuzzi played 12:05 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Chicago’s usual lines.
